text:
alex: Heads up — supplier sent a draft "governance appendix" that limits distribution to 'non-commercial research' unless we sign a separate redistribution addendum. This touches cloud marketplace listing and any HW bundle plans. Can legal/eng/partners weigh in?

julia: I saw it — red flag for marketplace. We need explicit permission to list the model as a served endpoint and to include a packaged HW SKU. We can do a 1-paragraph amendment.

mike: From eng: we already planned to serve a runtime-only variant (no weights redistributed). That covers hosted API. The HW bundle is trickier if partner wants weights on device. We'll need a signed manifest + checksum and a secure retrieval flow.

tara: Marketing: timeline impact — supplier expects joint PR if we list them on cloud marketplace. We can't commit to a date until legal clears redistribution rights. Also need co-branding assets and a 48hr embargo window.

oliver: HW partnerships side: our SI partner expects to ship a preloaded image for edge kits. If supplier won't allow redistribution, we can instead host a secure pull from the device at first boot (requires EULA update). That is an implementation workaround but legal still needs to sign off.

julia: Proposed legal blurb to propose back to supplier: ```
Permitted uses: Redwood may (i) host and operate the Model as a service for Redwood customers, (ii) list the Model on cloud marketplaces as a hosted offering, and (iii) enable hardware partners to facilitate end-user access via secure, authenticated retrieval mechanisms. Redistribution of model weight files to third parties requires a separate, written redistribution addendum executed by both parties.
```

aj: (typo) meant alex earlier — alex: If we push for the above, can we still do joint announcement with supplier and cloud partner?

julia: Yes, we can offer announcement cooperation for hosted listing and joint messaging about 'supported on Redwood' without distributing weights. For HW-bundles where weights are preinstalled, we need the addendum.

mike: Tech action: we'll build a small proof-of-concept for secure first-boot pull and manifest verification. ETA 48 hours once legal confirms the flow.

tara: Action items for comms: once legal confirms language, I need co-brand assets, final embargo time, and a 1-paragraph supplier quote. Target draft by Friday.

marketplace-bot: new_listing: Model listing draft created in staging (id: stg-ml-4821) — status: awaiting-legal-approval :white_check_mark:

alex: Ok — plan: 1) @julia send the amendment proposal to supplier today, 2) @mike start POC for secure pull, 3) @tara prepare comms template for Friday, 4) @oliver map HW bundle dependency and flag where addendum required. I'll sync with supplier tomorrow at 10am PT.

julia: I'll get the note out today and copy export-control for review.

mike: Starting POC now, posting updates in #eng-runtime.

tara: I'll assemble the comms packet and share with PR/legal channel once draft is ready.

alex: Thanks all — keeping this thread as single place for decisions. :thumbsup:
